reason: isRealName checks a spoken NAME against placeholder words ('guest', 'anonymous'), not a user id.
PLACEHOLDERS lists display-name placeholders ('the user', 'Visitor', 'anonymous') that are not the caller's NAME; it is never compared with a user id.
The id is only a hash seed that picks one of Ferni's own life threads; nothing about the caller is read or stored, so it is not used as a user id.
Linguistic mirroring keeps an in-process engine per id for this call and stores nothing; a unique anon:/onbehalf: id keys its own engine, only the shared 'anonymous' id would mix callers.
startReturningCaller runs only for an anon: session (an unverified phone caller), so it wants a non-member id, never a member's (RETURNING_CALLER, #1909).
Compares identificationSource, the identification-source enum ('anonymous' | 'device' | 'phone' ...), not a user id.
Compares a Firebase Auth providerId enum value ('anonymous' provider), not a user id.
Compares the Firebase Auth signInProvider enum ('anonymous' provider) of the two tokens being merged (#2226), not a user id.
Refuses a token whose Firebase Auth sign_in_provider enum is 'anonymous' (#2236); compares the provider, not a user id.
Records whether the verified token's Firebase Auth sign_in_provider enum is 'anonymous' (#2236/#2250); compares the provider, not a user id.
Notes a sports team in the in-process world cache for this call's id; nothing is written to Firestore, and a unique anon:/onbehalf: id only touches its own entry.

A real GATE (stores dates that matter after a call), left unconverted because the wellbeing after-call branch is changing this task. Convert it to isMemberIdentity once that branch merges; this entry then goes stale and fails.
Compares the decoded token's sign_in_provider enum value ('anonymous' provider), not a user id.

The opposite question: only a pre-sign-in device: or anon: id may be linked INTO a Firebase account, so it must require a non-account prefix, not refuse one. The second match compares the anon token's Firebase Auth signInProvider enum to 'anonymous' (#2226), not a user id.
Compares the Firebase sign-in provider enum ('anonymous' provider), not a user id: an anonymous Firebase user never counts as verified.

initWorldAwareness reads the caller's saved interests from Firestore (bogle_users/{id}/info_preferences) and warms the in-process world cache; cleanup clears that cache. An anon:/onbehalf: id has no saved doc, so the read returns nothing of anyone's, and strangers keep IP-located world context. Only the shared 'anonymous' id is refused.
Reads the in-process weather snapshot cached for this call's id; a unique anon:/onbehalf: id is safe and strangers still get the weather, only the shared 'anonymous' bucket would mix callers.
